items.name: airplane-hangar
items.text: The interior of a massive, empty airplane hangar with a high, curved steel-truss ceiling and a polished, sealed concrete floor.

items.name: abandoned-runway
items.text: An abandoned airport runway with cracked asphalt, faded yellow markings, and a derelict, glassless control tower.

items.name: industrial-park
items.text: An anonymous industrial park with simple, functional warehouses and loading bays.

items.name: shipping-dock-cranes
items.text: An industrial shipping dock, the scene dominated by the artificial lights of towering container cranes and immense, orderly stacks of cargo containers.

items.name: industrial-back-alley
items.text: A dimly lit back alley behind industrial buildings, with dumpsters and external pipes.

items.name: cooling-towers
items.text: A decommissioned nuclear power plant, with the two massive, concrete cooling towers silhouetted against the night sky and lit by stark, orange-toned security lights at their base.

items.name: flickering-industrial-street
items.text: An old industrial street with flickering streetlights, rusted metal fences, and graffiti-scarred walls.
